description:
Edit or moderate a forum post (thread): rename, retag, archive, lock, or pin.

Args:
  - post_id (string): Forum post (thread) ID
  - name (string, optional): New post title (max 100 characters)
  - applied_tags (string[], optional): Replace the post's tags with these tag IDs (max 5)
  - archived (boolean, optional): true to archive/close, false to reopen
  - locked (boolean, optional): true to lock (mods only can post), false to unlock
  - pinned (boolean, optional): true to pin to top of forum, false to unpin
  - auto_archive_duration ('60' | '1440' | '4320' | '10080', optional): Minutes before auto-archive

Returns:
  The updated forum post details

applied_tags.description: Replace the post's tags with this set of tag IDs (max 5). Supplying this replaces all existing tags

archived.description: Set true to archive (close) the post, false to reopen it

auto_archive_duration.description: Minutes of inactivity before the post auto-archives: '60' (1h), '1440' (1 day), '4320' (3 days), '10080' (1 week)

locked.description: Set true to lock the post (only moderators can send messages), false to unlock

pinned.description: Set true to pin the post to the top of the forum, false to unpin

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

name: discord_edit_forum_post
title: Edit Discord Forum Post
